packageRules.description: PyPI updates must satisfy the same 72-hour maturity window as uv exclude-newer = '3 days'; keep artifact generation reproducible.
Keep GitHub Actions Python on the Home Assistant/official pytest-validated 3.14 patch series; review new minor versions explicitly.
Home Assistant and the official pytest-homeassistant harness must advance together via the reviewed baseline updater (roadmap #109 phase 4). pytest-asyncio is owned by the official harness.
Freeze independently hash-locked HA 2026.11.0 minimum test environment; manual support-floor changes only.
